notes: FASER search for light long-lived particles decaying to photon pairs (57.7 fb^-1, 13.6 TeV). This is a real observed (non-projection) collider limit, but the paper's PRIMARY, world-leading result is on the ALP-W coupling g_aWW (coupling to weak gauge bosons, in GeV^-1), which does NOT map to any enum value. Secondary interpretations include ALP-photon (g_agamma, AxionPhoton, GeV^-1), ALP-gluon, U(1)_B baryonic vector boson, up-philic scalar, 2HDM, and a dark-photon reinterpretation (kinetic mixing chi, DarkPhoton) in the appendix. I selected AxionPhoton from the ALP-photon interpretation (Fig 11 left), where the text states FASER probes ALP masses up to ~80 MeV with couplings down to ~1e-4 GeV^-1; data points are approximate (two-point lower-boundary from text, exact contour not tabulated). Coupling type is ambiguous across multiple models (hence low confidence); this is a collider bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density.
